article_title: China AI: Data centres rise from the rolling plains of Inner Mongolia

tasks.prompt: What is the main idea of the article?
options: China is rapidly expanding AI infrastructure, while its strategy also raises environmental, social and economic questions.
Potato farming has replaced technology as Inner Mongolia's most important industry.
China has stopped developing AI because it cannot obtain advanced chips.
Most rural residents already use AI in their daily work.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה את ההתרחבות המהירה של מרכזי הנתונים ואת שאיפות ה־AI של סין, לצד מגבלות שבבים, השפעות סביבתיות וחששות של תושבים.
tasks.correct_answer: China is rapidly expanding AI infrastructure, while its strategy also raises environmental, social and economic questions.

tasks.prompt: What target has China's Communist Party set for the use of AI by 2030?
options: To move 90% of data centres outside China
To embed AI across 90% of industries and society
To replace 90% of university courses with AI
To export 90% of China's computer chips
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, היעד הוא לשלב בינה מלאכותית ב־90% מהתעשיות ומהחברה עד שנת 2030.
tasks.correct_answer: To embed AI across 90% of industries and society

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does the phrase “digital frontier” most nearly mean?
options: A border checkpoint controlled by computers
A rural region without internet access
An emerging area of technological development
A law limiting the movement of digital equipment
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר הכתבה, frontier הוא תחום חדש ומתפתח שבו מתרחשת התקדמות טכנולוגית מהירה, ולא גבול גאוגרפי.
tasks.correct_answer: An emerging area of technological development

tasks.prompt: What does “touting an alternate model” mean in the article's discussion of Chinese AI?
options: Secretly copying another country's system
Testing a model that has already failed
Removing an existing model from public use
Actively promoting a different approach
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפועל touting פירושו לקדם או לשבח דבר בפומבי. כאן סין מציגה ומקדמת גישה חלופית לפיתוח AI.

tasks.prompt: Why are some of China's data centres being built in rural provinces such as Inner Mongolia?
options: They offer renewable energy, cheaper land and a cooler climate.
They are closer to China's largest coastal universities.
They have no need for electricity or water.
They already produce all of China's advanced chips.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת זמינות של אנרגיית רוח ושמש, קרקע זולה יותר ומזג אוויר קריר שמפחית את צורכי הקירור והמים.
tasks.correct_answer: They offer renewable energy, cheaper land and a cooler climate.

tasks.prompt: When Professor Liu contrasts “conformity” with questioning, what does “conformity” mean?
options: Building technology at high speed
Following accepted ideas or rules rather than challenging them
Sharing open-source software internationally
Returning home after studying abroad
tasks.explanation_hebrew: conformity היא נטייה להתאים את עצמך לדעות או לכללים המקובלים. פרופ' ליו מציב אותה מול חשיבה ביקורתית והטלת ספק.
tasks.correct_answer: Following accepted ideas or rules rather than challenging them

tasks.prompt: Identify two environmental or social concerns connected with the new data centres.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: תשובה מלאה תציין שני חששות שונים המופיעים בכתבה ותסביר כל אחד בקצרה.
expected_points: Some electricity still comes from coal, despite the use of renewable energy.
Water use is a concern in arid Inner Mongolia.
Villages have been relocated and the scale or compensation is unclear.
Some residents fear losing land or livelihoods while seeing few local jobs.

tasks.prompt: Why may it be difficult to measure public attitudes toward China's AI expansion accurately?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסיק מן הכתבה מדוע נתונים או סקרים על דעת הקהל עשויים שלא לשקף את מלוא הביקורת, ולבסס את התשובה על פרט אחד לפחות.
expected_points: People may be reluctant to voice criticism because public dissent can be risky under censorship.
Concerns such as job-loss anxiety are difficult to measure openly.
Official optimism and survey results may not capture the scepticism expressed by some local residents.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how China is building its AI capacity and describe two challenges to that strategy.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להזכיר את מרכזי הנתונים או התשתיות, את מודל הקוד הפתוח או טיפוח הכישרונות, ושני אתגרים מבוססי כתבה.
expected_points: China is rapidly constructing large data centres and promoting broad adoption of AI.
It uses affordable open-source models and recruits or develops scientific talent.
US restrictions limit access to the most advanced chips.
Environmental, relocation, employment or freedom-of-inquiry concerns complicate the strategy.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, evaluate one strength and one weakness of China's approach to becoming an AI leader.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: התשובה צריכה להציג טענה מאוזנת, להביא ראיה ספציפית אחת לחוזקה וראיה ספציפית אחת לחולשה, ולהסביר כיצד הראיות תומכות במסקנה.
expected_points: Possible strengths include rapid infrastructure building, large numbers of science graduates, returning talent and open-source innovation.
Possible weaknesses include advanced-chip restrictions, coal or water impacts, displacement, limited local benefits or constraints on critical questioning.
The conclusion should weigh the chosen strength against the chosen weakness rather than merely list them.
